questions.prompt: Students were randomly assigned to a new study method (group A) or the usual method (group B). Box plots show a median of 78 for A and 70 for B, with similar spreads. Students were randomly assigned to a new study method (group A) or the usual method (group B). Box plots show a median of 78 for A and 70 for B, with similar spreads. In 1,000 random regroupings, a difference in means at least as large as observed happened 30 times.
Using a 5% threshold, is the difference significant?
